bio.text: Veronica Gonzalez is the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for the 74th Assembly District in Manhattan in the November 2026 election, challenging Democrat Keith Powers.
Our Town describes her as a community advocate and business owner who has lived in her Manhattan neighborhood for over two decades and is running for office for the first time.

sources.title: Veronica Gonzalez Runs for 74th Assembly District Seat on Republican Line
